description: Follow on Monity Network as this key's owner (needs a write-scope key): a tracker (its changes alert them; targetType WATCHLIST for a tracker with several sources, WATCH for a tracker with one source) or a person (HUNTER: their new trackers). follow_tracker works out the kind of tracker itself. For a one-source tracker, optionally a personal condition so only matching changes alert them (e.g. {kind: 'BELOW', amount: 150}, or {words: 'only when it is back in stock'}). Other followers are unaffected. Same quotas and limits as the app.

words.description: Instead of kind: the condition in plain words, e.g. "under 150"

ref.description: A tracker's slug or id, or a person's handle

targetType.description: Default WATCH (a tracker with one source); WATCHLIST for a tracker with several, HUNTER for a person

name: follow_network
title: Follow a tracker or a person
